name: clawstyle-ui
description: ClawStyle UI — community alternative frontend for the Hermes Agent dashboard, with the OpenClaw-inspired ClawStyle theme (snapshot of the upstream Hermes web/ at 48799de49, base 2f80ae0a6)

scripts.test: npm run test --workspace web && npm run test --workspace @hermes/shared && node --test ops/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: npm run test --workspace web && npm run test --workspace @hermes/shared
scripts.lint: eslint ops scripts eslint.config.mjs && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint:fix: eslint ops scripts eslint.config.mjs --fix && npm run lint:fix --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
